sources.title: Qwen/Qwen1.5-7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen1.5-7B Introduction Qwen1.5 is the beta version of Qwen2, a transformer-based decoder-only language model pretrained on a large amount of data. In comparison with the previous released Qwen, the improvements include: 8 model sizes, including 0.5B, 1.8B, 4B, 7B, 14B, 32B and 72B dense models, and an MoE model of 14B with 2.7B activated; Significant performance improvement in Chat models ...

In this work, we introduce Qwen, the first installment of our large language model series.
